info.title: APU EMS API
info.description:
REST API for the APU Event Management System.

The backend owns the proposal workflow state machine and every authorisation decision. Clients send actions and render what comes back; no permission rule is evaluated in the browser.

**Authentication.** `POST /auth/login` returns a short-lived access token and a longer-lived refresh token. Send the access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. On 401 with code `token_expired`, call `POST /auth/refresh`.

**Errors.** Every failure returns the same envelope: `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id"}}`. `message` is safe to display; `request_id` correlates with server logs.

**Rate limits.** 300 requests/minute overall, 10/minute on auth endpoints, keyed per authenticated user and falling back to client IP.

as a set - applied one row at a time, a page passes through states that
grant more (or less) than the admin intended.

A 'role' grant may only carry FLAT roles: a unit-scoped role there would
mean "Lecturer anywhere", which the model does not express.

post.description:
Guests may browse, save and register for public events. They can never
submit a proposal or reach any internal page - that is enforced by the
'external-user' role, which @require_internal rejects, not by anything the
client sends.

Returns the same envelope as login, so the caller is signed in immediately.
